notes: Turf Wars: 30 blocks, a Monday to Friday war, and 3 defences locks your block for the week. Names on the map never overlap, every crew gets its own colour, and you see a rival's full stats before you fight. Taking blocks is now checked by the server, so there's no way to claim without winning the fight. Clones update to your stats right away, learn from every fight (online too), react like you on a good day, mix up their attacks and adapt to what's working, so they're tougher to beat. Rebirth XP is +0.4x per rebirth.
